reviews.review:
Edit Jan 2026 after a few round of patching. 

Cool game for the price.

The Dev Team (1person, and pretty cool person at that) Is still developping features and slowly implementing them into the game I.e: Survivors, Combat system, Trade, Settlements, and much more.)
It takes time as a solo dev however. But for the price this game is at, Its a steal. 

There is plenty of small details and mechanics intertwined in the gameplay. Some Characters, Like the ship's Ai is so despicable you love to hate them. I believe he even had to be nerfed as he was such an ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥.

Do not let the minimalist pixel Graphics fool you, it is a Survival game and it is quite well made. Think Project Zomboid, with the status bars.

I found myself playing past my regular reasonable bedtime for someone working the next day, I had things to finish first in my survival run. Few games can absorb me like that...

Usually it means the survival aspect is well crafted and delivered in the game.

Can't wait for the combat system and the rest to be fleshed out.
